summary: Vancouver, Canada, Microsoft employee, Software Development Engineer II (SDE II), 7 years of coding experience, originally from Australia, strong interest in self-driving technology, computer vision, and machine learning, passionate about open-source projects, enjoys diving and has an advanced open water diver license, critical of US immigration and healthcare systems, advocates for better work-life balance and employee treatment, engaged in discussions about tech industry salaries and job markets, has a wife, interested in robotics and Raspberry Pi projects, supports environmental conservation efforts, skeptical of big tech companies' data practices, and values community-driven solutions.
